_comment: Model responses per case id, replayed by RecordedCopywriter in the offline eval. Hand-written stand-ins in the shape Claude returns until `python -m evals creative --writer claude --record` overwrites them with real ones. Some entries are deliberately bad (changed price, invalid output, timeout, bland) so the fallback path is measured too.
